name: Nuance Dragon Medical One
one_liner: Industry-leading cloud speech recognition for clinical dictation with 99%+ accuracy and deep EHR integration.
short_description: Dragon Medical One is Microsoft/Nuance's cloud-based clinical speech recognition platform for real-time medical dictation directly into EHRs.
long_description: Dragon Medical One (DMO) is the industry-leading cloud speech recognition platform for healthcare, acquired by Microsoft in 2021. Unlike ambient AI scribes, Dragon Medical One is a dictation tool where clinicians speak their notes section by section and the software converts speech to text with over 99% accuracy. The platform offers deep native integration with major EHRs including Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, and the broader Microsoft healthcare ecosystem. Dragon Medical One has won Best in KLAS for Speech Recognition: Front-End EHR for six consecutive years (2021-2026). The platform supports multiple languages including English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Swedish. Note: This is a dictation tool requiring clinicians to structure their own notes verbally—it does not passively capture ambient conversations or auto-generate notes like DAX Copilot.
best_for: Clinicians who prefer structured dictation over ambient capture
Health systems using Epic, Cerner, or Microsoft healthcare infrastructure
Organizations seeking proven, KLAS-validated speech recognition
not_for: Clinicians wanting passive ambient note generation
Mac users without virtualization (Windows-only native app)
Those seeking coding/billing automation (separate Dragon Medical Advisor add-on)

pricing.notes: Mandatory $525 one-time implementation fee per user. Sold through authorized resellers—no public price sheet. Optional PowerMic or SpeechMike hardware ($300-650). Extended training/customization $125-175/hour. No free trial available.

compliance.notes: Part of Microsoft's healthcare compliance framework. Enterprise-grade security.

integrations.name: Epic
integrations.notes: Deep native integration within Epic workflow

platforms.notes: Native app is Windows-only. Mac requires Parallels or VM. Mobile via PowerMic Mobile app.

features.awards: Best in KLAS Speech Recognition (2021-2026, 6 consecutive years)

faqs.q: How much does Dragon Medical One cost?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One costs $79-99/month depending on contract length (1-3 years), plus a mandatory $525 one-time implementation fee. Annual pricing ranges from $948 (3-year) to $1,188 (1-year). Optional microphone hardware adds $300-650.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Dragon Medical One and DAX Copilot?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One is a dictation tool where you speak your notes and it transcribes them. DAX Copilot is an ambient AI scribe that passively listens to patient encounters and auto-generates notes. Dragon Copilot bundles both capabilities together.

faqs.q: Does Dragon Medical One work on Mac?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One's native application is Windows-only. Mac users need Parallels or a virtual machine to run the Windows app. The mobile app (PowerMic Mobile) works on iOS.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Dragon Medical One integrate with?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One has deep native integration with Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, and the Microsoft health ecosystem. It also works with most other EHRs through its virtual channel dictation capabilities.

company_info.acquisition: Acquired by Microsoft in 2022 for $19.7 billion
company_info.notes: Nuance pioneered clinical speech recognition. Dragon Medical One is used by over 550,000 physicians worldwide.
